从 %@ 切换到 %@ 会更新以下发布规则。仓库、Token、作者和默认标签不会.zh-Hans: 从 %1$@ 切换到 %2$@ 会更新以下发布规则。仓库、Token、作者和默认标签不会改变。
从 %@ 切换到 %@ 会更新以下发布规则。仓库、Token、作者和默认标签不会.en: Switching from %1$@ to %2$@ updates the publishing rules below. The repository, token, author, and default tags will not change.

填写仓库 owner/name 后才能打开 PR/MR 创建页。: Enter the repository owner and name before opening the PR/MR creation page.
填写仓库 owner/name 后才能打开批量 PR/MR 创建页。: Enter the repository owner and name before opening the batch PR/MR creation page.
完成后会进入同步工作区并扫描仓库；发布前仍会要求检查和 Diff 确认。: When setup finishes, the app opens the Sync workspace and scans the repository. Checks and diff review are still required before publishing.
待发布队列没有可创建分支的文件。: The publishing queue has no files for creating a branch.
待发布队列没有可提交的文件。: The publishing queue has no files to commit.
待发布队列没有可生成 PR/MR 描述的文章。: The publishing queue has no articles for generating a PR/MR description.
截图模式：AI 助手 Inspector 已载入。: Screenshot mode: AI Assistant inspector loaded.
截图模式：写作工作区已载入演示文章。: Screenshot mode: demo article loaded in the Writing workspace.
截图模式：同步/API 发布工作区已载入。: Screenshot mode: Sync/API publishing workspace loaded.
截图模式：站点维护工作台已载入。: Screenshot mode: Site Maintenance workspace loaded.
支持 WordPress WXR、RSS/Atom、JSON 导出、单篇 Mar: Supports WordPress WXR, RSS/Atom, JSON exports, individual Markdown files, and Markdown folders.
文章已变化，未复制陈旧 AI Prompt；请重试。: The article changed, so the stale AI prompt was not copied. Try again.
未能保存仓库权限，请重新选择或检查文件夹访问权限。: Repository permission could not be saved. Select the folder again or check folder access.
确认后立即执行远端发布: Publishes to the remote repository immediately after confirmation
空项再按 Return: Press Return again on an empty item
请从顶部“发布”菜单打开统一发布流程。: Open the unified publishing flow from the Publish menu at the top.
请从顶部发布状态打开统一发布流程。: Open the unified publishing flow from the publishing status at the top.
请修复保存位置或权限后重试。应用将保持打开，避免丢失未保存修改。: Fix the save location or permissions and try again. The app will remain open to avoid losing unsaved changes.
请关闭确认页，刷新发布快照后重新审阅。: Close this confirmation page, refresh the publishing snapshot, and review it again.
请确认远端、分支、发布方式和完整文件清单。确认后会立即写入远端。: Confirm the remote repository, branches, publishing method, and full file list. Confirmation writes to the remote repository immediately.
选择包含站点配置和内容目录的仓库根目录。: Choose the repository root containing the site configuration and content directory.
选择博客导出包或 Markdown 文件夹: Choose a Blog Export or Markdown Folder
选择本地仓库后才能生成分支发布命令。: Select a local repository before generating branch publishing commands.
选择本地仓库后才能生成同步建议命令。: Select a local repository before generating sync recommendation commands.
选择本地仓库后才能生成提交命令。: Select a local repository before generating commit commands.
选择要导入的文章。相同仓库路径的现有草稿会先保存版本快照，再使用远端内容更新。: Select the articles to import. Existing drafts at the same repository path are snapshotted before being updated with remote content.
通过发布控制台菜单进入: Open from the Publishing Console menu
先完成一次仓库扫描，才会显示变更、自动化和本地预览模块。上方主操作可开始扫描。: Complete one repository scan first to show changes, automation, and local preview. Use the primary action above to start.
原始图片不会被覆盖，处理结果以新副本保存并更新草稿引用。: Original images are not overwritten. Results are saved as new copies and draft references are updated.
处理期间可以取消；取消后不会应用结果，临时文件会被清理。: You can cancel during processing. Canceled results are not applied and temporary files are removed.
定时执行 Fetch 与差异检查；不会自动导入或合并文章。: Runs scheduled Fetch and difference checks. Articles are never imported or merged automatically.
开始前请核对影响范围、输出格式和恢复方式。: Review the affected scope, output format, and recovery method before starting.
当前已选择的站点类型、仓库和发布方式会保留，可稍后在设置中继续修改。: The selected site type, repository, and publishing method are retained and can be changed later in Settings.
按原格式生成缩小尺寸的图片副本。: Generate resized image copies in their original formats.
没有一步撤销；如需回退，可在文章版本历史中恢复批处理前内容。: There is no one-step undo. To revert, restore the pre-batch content from article version history.
生成 WebP 副本，并把草稿图片引用更新为 WebP。: Generate WebP copies and update draft image references to WebP.
生成优化后的 JPEG 副本，保留 JPEG 格式。: Generate optimized JPEG copies while keeping the JPEG format.
生成精简后的 SVG 副本，保留 SVG 格式。: Generate optimized SVG copies while keeping the SVG format.
预计节省量按当前扫描体积和候选图片比例估算，实际结果以处理完成后的统计为准。: Estimated savings are based on the current scanned size and candidate-image ratio. Actual results are shown after processing.

从 %@ 切换到 %@ 会更新以下发布规则。仓库、访问令牌、作者和默认标签不会改.zh-Hans: 从 %1$@ 切换到 %2$@ 会更新以下发布规则。仓库、访问令牌、作者和默认标签不会改变。
从 %@ 切换到 %@ 会更新以下发布规则。仓库、访问令牌、作者和默认标签不会改.en: Switching from %1$@ to %2$@ updates the publishing rules below. The repository, access tokens, author, and default tags will not change.

仓库 API 基础地址必须使用 HTTPS，且不能包含用户名、密码、查询参数（Q: The repository API base URL must use HTTPS and cannot contain a username, password, query, or fragment. Access tokens are never sent to unsafe configurations.
展开后可配置轮询、查看集成深度和手动刷新部署状态。: Expand to configure polling, review integration depth, and refresh deployment status manually.
部署访问令牌与仓库访问令牌使用独立的钥匙串项；切换部署平台后需要保存该平台自己的: Deployment and repository access tokens use separate Keychain items. After switching deployment providers, save that provider's token separately. A legacy shared token is not reused automatically as a deployment token.
GitHub/GitLab 会优先读取 Pages 与构建状态；Netlify: GitHub and GitLab prioritize Pages and build status. Netlify reads recent deployments after you enter a site ID and access token. Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, and custom providers use the configured status endpoint or site URL for post-publish checks. Only HTTPS status endpoints for custom providers can use a bearer token.
这些规则会随当前站点配置进入 AI 聊天、元数据建议、发布检查、选区编辑和图片替: These rules follow the current site configuration into AI chat, metadata suggestions, publishing checks, selection editing, and image alt-text or caption suggestions.
平台部署访问令牌只发送到平台官方 API；如需向状态端点发送 Bearer To: Provider deployment access tokens are sent only to the provider's official API. To send a bearer token to a status endpoint, choose the Custom Endpoint provider and use HTTPS.
预览会转换文章头信息（Front Matter）、Slug、图片目标路径和重定向: The preview converts article metadata (Front Matter), slugs, image destination paths, and redirect candidates without copying files or accessing the network.
保存访问令牌后，可在这里检查当前仓库是否具备写入权限。: After saving an access token, check here whether the current repository has write access.
当前站点配置没有可纳入发布队列的文章。: The current site configuration has no articles eligible for the publishing queue.
文章头信息包含 draft 字段: Include the draft Field in Article Metadata
文章头信息包含封面图字段: Include the Cover Image Field in Article Metadata
完成后会进入同步工作区并扫描仓库；发布前仍会要求检查和差异确认。: When setup finishes, the app opens the Sync workspace and scans the repository. Checks and difference review are still required before publishing.
生成模板文件、首篇文章、部署说明和本地站点配置。: Generate template files, the first article, deployment instructions, and a local site configuration.
状态端点使用部署访问令牌: Use Deployment Access Token for Status Endpoint
仅用于自定义 HTTPS 状态端点: Used only for the custom HTTPS status endpoint
仅用于当前部署平台的官方 API: Used only for the current deployment provider's official API
选择或新建文章后，这里会显示文章头信息（Front Matter）、SEO、图片: After selecting or creating an article, its article metadata (Front Matter), SEO, images, checks, and publishing tasks appear here.
当前站点配置没有可统计的文章。: The current site configuration has no articles to summarize.
损坏账本会先保留为备份，然后创建空账本。已有资料不会被删除，但旧操作回执将不再用: The corrupted ledger will be preserved as a backup before an empty ledger is created. Existing data will not be deleted, but old operation receipts will no longer be used for deduplication.
